trailhead.label: The church of San Giovanni Evangelista, Bruzolo, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
The board advises against summer, when it is too hot: go in spring or autumn and carry water for your dog.
Stretches on the hamlet road, including about 800 m of asphalt from Chiotetti: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Old cobbled mule tracks, steep in places (T2): watch your dog’s footing when wet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The church of San Giovanni Evangelista,: La chiesa di San Giovanni Evangelista, Bruzolo, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.The board advises against summer, when i: Il sito ufficiale lo sconsiglia d’estate, quando fa troppo caldo: vai in primavera o in autunno e porta acqua per il cane.
textIt.Stretches on the hamlet road, including: Tratti sulla strada delle borgate, tra cui circa 800 m di asfalto da Chiotetti: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Old cobbled mule tracks, steep in places: Antiche mulattiere acciottolate, ripide in alcuni tratti (T2): attenzione all’appoggio del cane quando è bagnato.
